==Usage==
<pre>
{{SWGWiki|url (optional)|text (optional)}}
</pre>
"url" is the name of the article on the SWG wiki (the part of the URL right after <code>/wiki/</code>).  If omitted, it defaults to the name of the Wookieepedia article using the template, minus any <code>/Legends</code> suffix.  "text" is what you wish to be the link text.  If omitted, it defaults to the "url" parameter.
